title: UWell Caliburn X Pod Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The UWell Caliburn X is an upscale entry to the Caliburn series. Featuring adjustable output power and activation functions and an OLED screen, the Caliburn X is a multifunctional pod system with a compact body. UWell’s Pro-FOCS flavour adjustment technology brings a unique advantage to the Caliburn X, giving you an authentic flavour experience.
Constructed from durable aluminum-alloy, the chassis of the UWell Caliburn X Pod Kit offers a strong and resilient chassis against light falls and drops.
Equipped with an 850mAh battery, the integrated battery delivers plenty of vapor throughout the day, allowing the UWell Caliburn X Pod Kit to output 5-20W easily.
In addition, the refillable pods hold up to 3ml, and utilizes an e-liquid viewing window to ensure a minimum fill level to prevent any dry hits or burning of the coil.
The device’s outer case airflow adjustment valve is convenient for vapers to control airflow. There is no need to remove the pod to adjust airflow.
The OLED screen on the device displays battery life, output power, voltage, coil resistance, and puffs. The visualization of data and operation is practical and user-friendly.
